title: Franke — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Franke.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Swiss Kitchen Systems." Specialty tier. Franke Group is a Swiss company making kitchen systems — sinks, faucets, range hoods, and cooking appliances. Their ventilation and sink systems are premium-grade with Swiss engineering.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Complete kitchen system projects. Premium sink and ventilation buyers.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Franke:

• Swiss engineering across kitchen systems

• Premium sinks and faucets

• Owns Faber ventilation

• Integrated kitchen solutions

• European quality standards
